technical_quality: Adequate PA frontal film with an "L" side marker (plus technologist initials) over the patient's left upper corner confirming conventional orientation; adequate inspiration, no significant rotation. Large bilateral breast shadows overlie both lower zones and obscure the right costophrenic angle and right heart border; retrocardiac and subdiaphragmatic regions are relatively underpenetrated.

devices.type: Small linear metallic density (surgical clip vs metallic foreign body), ~1 cm, single straight rod-like
devices.location: Patient left, medial mid-to-lower zone, immediately lateral to the left heart border below the left hilum (projected over left lower lobe)

devices.type: Radiographic side marker 'L' with technologist initials (mirrored text)
devices.location: Image upper right corner, over patient's left shoulder soft tissue / outside lung

abnormalities.finding: Well-circumscribed, dense (calcified-appearing) round nodule ~1 cm, paramediastinal, just above the right hilum at approximately the level of the aortic knob (upper/middle zone junction); most likely a calcified granuloma - this is the nodule matching the dataset label
Additional tiny dense dot ~0.4 cm at the upper right hilum (small calcified granuloma/node vs end-on vessel)
Borderline-to-mildly enlarged cardiac silhouette (estimated CTR ~0.53-0.55); right heart border partly obscured by breast shadow
Prominent, unfolded aortic knob with tortuous thoracic aorta (age-related)
Mildly elevated right hemidiaphragm relative to the left
Large bilateral breast shadows overlying the lower zones (obscuring right costophrenic angle); left costophrenic angle sharp, no visible pleural effusion or pneumothorax

description_zh: PA 正面胸部X光，影像右上方可見「L」側別標記，吸氣深度尚可，無明顯旋轉，但雙側乳房陰影大範圍遮蔽下肺野及右側肋膈角。右上肺野內側（右肺門上方、約主動脈弓高度，位於上／中肺野交界）可見一顆約1公分、邊緣清楚、密度偏高疑似鈣化之圓形結節，右肺門上方另見一約0.4公分的小鈣化點；此結節與資料集標籤相符，影像特徵較偏向鈣化性肉芽腫。左心緣旁、左肺門下方可見一枚約1公分的細長線狀金屬密度影，疑為手術夾或金屬異物，未見胸管、引流管或其他導管。心影略大（CTR約0.53–0.55，右心緣部分被乳房陰影遮蔽），主動脈弓突出迂曲，右側橫膈略高於左側，左側肋膈角銳利，未見明顯肋膜積液或氣胸。
